Good Times and Tan Lines by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Escape to a world of luxury and leisure in this stunning vacation home, a triumph of modern design, a perfect blend of sophistication and comfort. With contemporary finishes and a mesmerizing outdoor oasis featuring a private pool, your getaway is destined to be nothing short of extraordinary. The heart of the residence is its chef's kitchen, complete with an extra-large island. A full wall of sliding doors opens to an expansive deck overlooking the pool. Whether you're savoring a gourmet meal or lounging in the sun, this space is designed for indulgence. The outdoor area is a haven for relaxation and entertainment, the cozy living space gives parents a chance to unwind with a refreshing drink while keeping an eye on the kids splashing in the pool. The swaying hammocks, an invitation for a relaxing sway in the breeze. Offering convenience, the first floor has a guest bedroom, king, the second floor, two additional bedrooms, kings.

The primary bedroom, with a spa-like bathroom, is a sanctuary of its own, featuring a cozy seating area with a fireplace and TV, a wet/coffee bar, and a private balcony. A charming bar area welcomes you to the third floor, before leading to two more bedrooms. A guest room, queen, and a bunk room with four twins provide flexible sleeping arrangements for your group. Indulge in the epitome of luxury, meticulously curated to ensure a vacation experience that exceeds expectations. This home invites you to create cherished memories in an ambiance of opulence, beauty, and relaxation. Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - .2 miles to the beach (Eastern Lake Access) In the event of a high outflow at the Eastern Lake access point, please use the Ramsgate access to the west. - 5 bedroom, 4.5 bath - 2800 sq ft - Private pool (can be heated seasonally for an additional $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) - Gas grill - Wi-Fi included - 4 bikes included - Parking limited to 3 vehicles with no street parking - Dogs considered under 50 lbs ($210 non-refundable per dog, 2 dogs max) Overnight: - King in 1st floor guest room; private bath - King in 2nd floor primary bedroom; private bath - King in 2nd floor primary bedroom; private bath - King in 3rd floor guest room; shared bath - 4 twins (2 twin over twin bunks) in 3rd floor bunk room; shared bath Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Check-out is 10:00 AM CST.
